title: [전공디자인센터] 전공박람회 안내 (11/3 ~ 11/4)

summary: 전공디자인센터에서 교내 학과 및 전공 소개, 다중전공 선택 및 진로 설계를 지원하기 위해 전공박람회를 개최합니다.
인하대학교 재학생 및 휴학생이 대상이며, 별도 URL을 통해 전공멘토링 사전신청을 할 수 있습니다.

en.title: [Major Design Center] Major Fair Notice (11/3 ~ 11/4)
summary: The Major Design Center is holding a Major Fair to introduce academic departments and majors and support multiple major choices and career planning.
The event takes place daily from 10:00 to 17:00, November 3 (Tue) through November 4 (Wed), 2026.
The location is the 1st floor lobby of the 60th Anniversary Hall.
Enrolled students (재학생) and students on leave of absence (휴학생) at Inha University are eligible, and pre-application for major mentoring is available via the provided link.
en.easyExplanation: A Major Fair is being held for Inha University enrolled students and students on leave of absence to help with multiple major selection and career planning. It takes place at the 1st floor lobby of the 60th Anniversary Hall from November 3 to November 4, 2026, and students can sign up for major mentoring via the pre-application link.
en.target: Enrolled students (재학생) and students on leave of absence (휴학생) of Inha University
